description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the ratio and minADE20, comparing different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Ratio", has a linear scale, ranges from 0.1 to 1.0, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "minADE20", has a linear scale, ranges from 0.55 to 0.75, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The plot includes five lines: "Head Tuning" in orange with a solid line and circle markers, decreasing from approximately 0.79 at a ratio of 0.1 to 0.72 at a ratio of 1.0; "FT" in green with a solid line and circle markers, decreasing from 0.68 at a ratio of 0.1 to 0.54 at a ratio of 1.0; "LoRA 16" in red with a solid line and circle markers, decreasing from 0.75 at a ratio of 0.1 to 0.60 at a ratio of 1.0; "LoRA 64" in purple with a solid line and circle markers, decreasing from 0.76 at a ratio of 0.1 to 0.60 at a ratio of 1.0; and an unnamed method in blue with a solid line and circle markers, remaining relatively stable around 0.60 across the ratio range, with values ranging from 0.61 at a ratio of 0.1 to 0.59 at a ratio of 1.0.
